incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large plume of dark smoke and lighter-colored smoke or dust rises from the horizon, dominating the sky above a line of trees and some houses.

observations.description: Large, dense, dark grey smoke plume rising from the horizon, with lighter, more diffuse smoke or dust to the right.
Dark line of coniferous trees along the horizon, with some deciduous trees and bushes in the foreground.
One or more houses visible on the right side of the image, partially obscured by smoke and trees.
Overcast sky with heavy, swirling clouds, suggesting storm or fire-related conditions.

not_determinable: extent of fire or smoke plume
